about.title:
A connection is just
the beginning.
about.description: Local artisans have deep knowledge of their craft. College students bring fresh digital skills. We’re building the support system that helps them grow together.
about.missionTitle: Local talent deserves a wider world.
about.missionText: Our purpose is to make practical digital support more accessible to artisans, while giving students meaningful experience with real businesses. The platform stays involved in verification, matching and the work that follows.
about.journeyTitle: A guided journey, from hello to progress.

journey.title: Introduce yourself

journey.title: Agree on a clear plan

journey.title: Work, review and grow
journey.description: Track progress, record payments made outside the platform and get help when needed. Reflect on the work through reviews.

faqs.title: Is Bharat Bazaar a freelancer directory?
faqs.description: It is a managed growth platform. The planned experience includes verification, matching, agreements, progress tracking and ongoing support throughout a partnership.

faqs.title: Does the platform process payments?
faqs.description: No. The planned Payments area records payments made outside Bharat Bazaar. This phase has no payment gateway, fund transfers or payment verification.

faqs.title: Can I register or start a project today?
faqs.description: Yes, you can create an account and complete your profile. Student profiles go to an admin for review. Growth requests and projects are planned for later phases.

faqs.title: Which languages can I use?
faqs.description: This foundation includes English and Hindi. Use the language selector in the header to switch. The translation structure can support more languages later.
